tickets.title: Prepare destination note for Raina Bramblequill
tickets.text: Prepare a concise destination note for Raina Bramblequill covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions, incorporating the $4.6 million gross consideration, $350,000 escrow holdback, and $2,765,000 recent deposit.
tickets.evidence: Raina asked for a concise destination note covering operating cash, reserves, estimated taxes, investment staging, and CPA and attorney questions; the agreed follow-up is due January 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain executed escrow agreement and working-capital schedule
tickets.text: Obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from the sale file to reconcile the net proceeds, as the closing binder and bank deposit differed without identifying escrow, advisory fees, legal fees, or working-capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: The agreed January 3, 2025 follow-up is to obtain the executed escrow agreement and final working-capital schedule missing from the sale file.
